name: Korg KRONOS Global
description: Korg KRONOS: its Global settings (tuning, curves, controller assignments, user scales, audio inputs, MIDI) by SysEx parameter change, read back from Global.

sources.title: KRONOS MIDI Implementation: Global, Version 1.01 (Aug 6, 2014), object version 1
sources.notes: Rows read by tools/profiles/korg/read-kronos-table.mjs from Global.txt (sha256 f9710b900bfe80abf68d193cdbb089c01504618e1cc1f202bbc32056d9a4f230) in KRONOS_MIDIimp.zip of 2025-07-24, https://www.korg.com/us/support/download/manual/0/988/5480/. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/korg/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/korg/synths/, not this file.

Every row of Global.txt with a parameter id is a parameter, named by its group and its name as printed, and sent by Parameter Change (function 43): F0 42 3g 68 43 TYP SOC SUB PID IDX and the value as 21 bits, two's complement, high byte first (*4). Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

The rows of KARMA… go by KARMA Parameter Change (function 6D), the same message as Parameter Change under another code. The table prints no message per row. Per group, the rows whose ids Parameter Change also takes for another row, and so cannot go by it: . A group with such rows cannot go by Parameter Change; one with none goes by 6D on the message's name alone. A reading, not tried on an instrument.

The rows of Drum Track… go by Drum Track Parameter Change (function 6E), the same message as Parameter Change under another code. The table prints no message per row. Per group, the rows whose ids Parameter Change also takes for another row, and so cannot go by it: . A group with such rows cannot go by Parameter Change; one with none goes by 6E on the message's name alone. A reading, not tried on an instrument.

Global: tuning, curves, the controllers' assignments and polarities, the user scales, the audio inputs and the MIDI settings. The KRONOS takes global parameters in Global mode ("Which parameters are currently available for editing depends on the instrument's mode"). The effects' own parameters, which depend on the effect type (Effect.txt), are not here.

A range whose first value is the larger (9D~63) is two's complement over its bytes, -99~+99. A choice is a row naming both of two values. The value column is 19 characters wide; a name it cuts short keeps its cut, with an ellipsis. Other value names are in each parameter's description.

Left out: 1024 settings (MIDI (External Set1 - Knob1) Channel; MIDI (External Set1 - Knob2) Channel; MIDI (External Set1 - Knob3) Channel; MIDI (External Set1 - Knob4) Channel; MIDI (External Set1 - Knob5) Channel; MIDI (External Set1 - Knob6) Channel; …): the table prints one id for each setting of its 128 numbered copies ("MIDI (External Set# - Knob#) Channel"), unmarked, and does not say which copy is meant.

Pull: Current Object Dump Request (function 74) for object 03, the global, answered by a Current Object Dump (function 75) carrying object version 1 and 24708 bytes in Korg's 8-in-7 packing (*3: 28238 bytes). 480 parameters are read back at their rows' offsets and bits. A dump of any other length does not match.
Sent and not read back: 1 setting (MIDI Note Receive (bit 0, 00~02)): its bits are printed narrower than its range (`bit 0` for `00~02`), so where its value ends in the byte is not said.
The exclusive header carries the global MIDI channel as 3g; the profile's deviceId variable is that byte, 30H for channel 1.

Identity: the Device Inquiry reply (KRONOS_MIDI_Implementation.pdf) is printed F0 7E 0g 06 02 42 68 00 mm 00 vv ww xx 00 F7. Its 7th to 8th bytes, 68 00, are checked as printed, where the universal reply puts the family code; its 9th byte, mm, is one per model and is not checked: KRONOS/KRONOS2 61Keys 05H, KRONOS/KRONOS2 73Keys 0EH, KRONOS/KRONOS2 88Keys 17H, KRONOS3 61Keys 1DH, KRONOS3 73Keys 26H, KRONOS3 88Keys 2FH.
No preset recall: the implementation prints no banks for this object.
